When the midnight bell tolls, when the stars twinkle in the sky, when you wander on the boundary between dreams and realityвЂ”do you hear it? The whisper from the depths, the call of peace. 

 We are the Requiem Poetry Society. 

 Under the Goddess's gaze, we are the guardians of the night, the singers for the dead, and the keepers of secrets. We believe: 

 The night is not the source of horror, but a dwelling of peace. Death is not the sorrow of an ending, but the beginning of liberation. We use poetry to soothe the insomniac, rituals to pacify the spirits, and silence to guard the secrets that cannot be spoken. 

 If you are willing to join us, please come to the depths of Raphael Cemetery on the night of the new moon and recite the prayer: 

 "Goddess, please let peace descend, 
 Let dreams wrap the weary soul, 
 Let the night shelter the lost lamb." 

 We will welcome you in the darkness. 
 We will recognize you in the silence. 
 We will remember you in poetry. 

 But remember, becoming a member of the Requiem Poetry Society means you will take on corresponding responsibilitiesвЂ”staying awake while others sleep, remaining silent when the world is noisy, and embracing the darkness when the light is intense. 

 Are you ready? May the night shelter you, may peace be with you.

Raphael, as the younger brother of the Viscountess, died on the night of the family's destruction years ago. 
 He was a strong child in his lifetime, proud of his fists and strength, and was his sister's loyal follower and Guardian. 
 After he was reborn under the gaze of the Great Mother, he became even more powerful and fierce, at the cost of losing human intelligence and forgetting everything from his past lifeвЂ”except for one thing: he had to guard someone. 
 Who was it... where... the person to protect... must not forget... 
 "Stay here well and complete the guardianship of the offspring." After many years had passed, a voice said to him. 
 Raphael leaned against the giant cocoon, feeling a special throb, as if it were a call from his bloodline, waking him from his stupor. He instinctively opened his mouth to call out a word buried deep in his memory: Sister... Sister... 
 I finally found you... Sister... 
 The light of the crimson ring flashed by. 
 He had never forgotten the promise of his childhood. 
 Even if he had become a terrifying sight, he would surely use all his strength to guard everything he cherished.

ref_en:
For some time, excessive use of and addiction to online games among minors have become serious problems, adversely affecting their normal lives, studies, and healthy development. These concerns have prompted strong public responses, particularly from parents. To further strengthen management, prevent minors from becoming addicted to online games, and protect their physical and mental health, the following requirements are hereby announced.

I. Strictly limit the hours during which online gaming services are provided to minors. From the effective date of this notice, all online gaming companies may provide minors with only 1 hour of online gaming services, from 20:00 to 21:00, on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays, and statutory holidays. At all other times, online gaming services must not be provided to minors in any form.

II. Strictly enforce real-name registration and login requirements for online gaming accounts. All online games must connect to the National Press and Publication Administration's real-name verification system for preventing online gaming addiction. All users must register and log in using genuine, valid identity information. Online gaming companies must not provide services in any form, including guest trial modes, to users who have not registered and logged in under their real identities.

III. Publishing authorities at all levels shall strengthen supervision and inspection of online gaming companies' compliance with service hours and duration limits, real-name registration and login, payment practices, and related requirements. Inspections shall be more frequent and rigorous. Companies that fail to comply strictly shall be dealt with seriously in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

<Title> Faction Battle </> 
 Clubs participating in the Strategic Server will start a one-month Faction Battle based on the finalized factions. Participate in gameplay such as <Highlight> Frost-Fall Lord, Strategic Server City of Dragon Hunting, Club Conquest Decree, and Strategic Server Final Hunt </> to obtain Club God-Chosen Points and compete for God-Chosen seats based on weekly and final rankings. The God-Chosen seats obtained by the Club are distributed internally by the Club management. 
 
 <Title> Strategic Preparation </> 
 This Strategic Server will open three exclusive strategic preparations: 
 <Highlight> Strategic Skills: </> Each Pathway can obtain exclusive Strategic Skills; using them reasonably will have a significant impact on the battle. 
 <Highlight> Historical Crystals: </> Players can use Historical Crystals to upgrade Sealed Artifacts to Level 1 and gradually unlock additional slots for equipping Beyonder materials. 
 <Highlight> Emperor's Journey: </> Participating in various Strategic Server gameplay can earn Conquest Reputation, which can be used to increase the Strategic Server military rank. 
 <Highlight> The above preparations only take effect within the Strategic Server </>. 
 
 <Title> God-Chosen Glory </> 
 After the Faction Battle ends, the <Highlight> Victor's Declaration </> ceremony will begin. After the ceremony, God-Chosen seat rewards and limited-time divine descent will be distributed uniformly. Subsequently, this server's <Highlight> Trade War </> will be opened based on each Club's God-Chosen Points; stay tuned.

A long, long time ago, the Tree of Abundance was just a tiny seed. 

 It slept in the Church of the Earth Mother, carefully guarded by a Saint. The Saint knew it carried two powerful forces, vitality and desolation, and could not be easily planted. 

 Until the war of broken oaths arrived. The earth turned to scorched soil, vitality was annihilated one after another, and the Saint stood among the corpses of companions and enemies, shedding a tear. 

 At the very least, let this land be reborn. 

 After the seed entered the soil, it grew rapidly. When vitality suddenly arrived, desolation also stretched out its clawsвЂ”so the Saint stepped forward, taking all the endless desolation into their own body. 

 The turmoil finally subsided, and the Tree of Abundance opened its eyes. 

 She turned into a humanoid spirit, ignorant as a baby, wrapped in a golden cloak. 

 A distant voice echoed in her heart: 

 This is the gift of the earth. 

 This is the call of abundance.

      Furniture was spewing milk, mushrooms were descending from the ceiling, and the scattered soil was pulsating like flesh, after which Mr. First Mate poked his head out from the pile of dirt.
      "Hello, I heard from the Captain that you wanted the kind of mushrooms used against the Primordial Moon believers previously." Frank Lee revealed an enthusiastic smile. "You'll have to wait a moment. Hmm, would you like some fruit juice?"
      "Fruit juice..." Alger looked solemnly toward the corner of the room, where a vine growing on beef was dripping with fragrant juice.
      "No, I'm not thirsty for now." Alger shook his head cautiously.
      Frank looked slightly regretful, but soon smiled again: "The Captain said I could request some reasonable compensation... Mr. Alger, you are a high-Sequence Beyonder of the Sailor pathway..."
      Alger became vigilant.
      "Could you provide some of your flesh after your marine creature transformation? I want to know if this 'fish meat' can react with the mushrooms..."

 The first category is to obtain revelations through "sensing" by using the "power" of the person asking, such as Tarot divination and poker divination.

This world is just too boring! There aren't even any decent novels, let alone web novels, games, or movies; I have to write them myself. 
 It has been a long time since I transmigrated to this world. Ever since I became a Beyonder of the Savant pathway, I have been able to recall all the knowledge I learned before thanks to the power of the potion. Praise compulsory education and my undergraduate degree! Then I copied everything... oh, I mean, I spread advanced culture and knowledge to this world. 
 Relying on my talent and charm, the nobles courted me, the churches liked me, and the declining Gustav family stood at the pinnacle of this kingdom once again. My cheap old man and mom really should thank me. But I also miss my real home; becoming a Beyonder of this pathway is also to find a way back home. Huang Tao, oh Huang Tao, you must not forget your original intention; you still need to diligently increase your Sequence. 
 That old liar Zaratul of the Seer pathway taught me quite a bit of Beyonder knowledge, but whenever it involves true secrets, he starts smiling without a word, saying over and over that I need to help him steal that Antigonus Notebook from the church. 
 Let me say it again: once I become a high-Sequence powerhouse, I will beat up every Seer I see!

 Sunny. The sunlight reflected by the snow-covered mountains is very dazzling. To avoid eye strain, I suggested Neil go out after sunset. He didn't take my words to heart, packed our things on his own, and left first. He's always like this. 
 I packed up and caught up with him. Looking from afar, he had five shadows in the snow, walking in five directions. 
 Maybe I saw wrong, looking again, there was only one left. 
 We camped halfway up the mountain, it shouldn't be far from the summit. 
 
 Remaining supplies: 
 4.5 loaves of bread 
 3 portions of jerky and sausage 
 1 jar of sugar 
 3 blocks of butter 
 2 bottles of liquor 
 5 bottles of water. Found a water source on the way and replenished.
